description: This file declares the interface for the factory class IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory, which provides methods to create instances of server management modules within the Rialto IPC framework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external dependencies related to server management and IPC.

classes.name: IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of ServerManagerModule and related services within the Rialto IPC framework.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new instance of IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a ServerManagerModule object, given a reference to an ISessionServerManager.
